items.question: Donne toutes les combinaisons possibles de trois médicaments différents.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m1.cis AS cis1, m1.denomination AS med1,
                   m2.cis AS cis2, m2.denomination AS med2,
                   m3.cis AS cis3, m3.denomination AS med3
FROM medicaments m1
JOIN medicaments m2 ON m1.cis < m2.cis
JOIN medicaments m3 ON m2.cis < m3.cis

items.question: Croise chaque composition avec chaque présentation de chaque autre médicament et compte les lignes obtenues.
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS nb_lignes
FROM compositions c1
JOIN presentations p1 ON c1.cis = p1.cis
JOIN compositions c2 ON c2.cis <> c1.cis
JOIN presentations p2 ON c2.cis = p2.cis

FROM compositions c1
JOIN presentations p1 ON c1.cis = p1.cis
JOIN compositions c2 ON c2.cis <> c1.cis
JOIN presentations p2 ON c2.cis = p2.cis
WHERE c1.substance = c2.substance
